## Change

Describe the trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List checks actually run and material limitations.

## Compatibility

Use a Conventional Commit PR title. For incompatible changes, add `!` to the
title and a `BREAKING CHANGE: ...` footer below that explains the impact and
migration. Keep that footer in the squash commit message. See
[versioning and releases](../docs/versioning.md).
